notes: Resolver evals default to passive: read-only proof, per-comment drafts, no code patches even scratch and no posts. Explicit aggressive selection authorizes proven in-scope fixes/tests/replies subject to all caller restrictions. Never merge, approve, deploy, or toggle resolution state.

evals.name: resolve-one-thread-by-id
evals.prompt: Resolve discussion abc123 on this GitLab MR without posting anything: https://gitlab.agodadev.io/Activities/activity-marketing-spark/-/merge_requests/352
evals.expected_output: The run resolves exactly one matching thread, validates its concrete claim with bounded evidence, and drafts a reply/resolution recommendation without writing.
assertions: one-thread-mode: report says it resolved one target thread, not all MR threads
claim-extracted: report states the concrete claim and suggested change
bounded-proof: report uses read-only, local, or clearly capped validation
no-writes: report states no GitLab write, suggestion apply, push, approval, merge, or resolve happened

evals.name: resolve-all-open-threads
evals.prompt: Resolve all open review threads on this GitLab MR and do not post anything: https://gitlab.agodadev.io/bookingapi/booking-creation/-/merge_requests/9106
evals.expected_output: Fetch every discussion page and account for every selected root/followup note with verdict, evidence, draft and disposition; exclude only evidenced system/own generated events. No writes in passive mode.
assertions: all-thread-mode: report says the MR URL alone triggered all-open-thread resolution
per-comment-accounting: every selected note/followup has a verdict and draft
deduplicated: duplicate comments are grouped or marked duplicate
no-writes: no GitLab write or CI trigger occurred

evals.name: incorrect-reviewer-suggestion
evals.prompt: Validate this reviewer comment on https://gitlab.agodadev.io/team/sample-backend/-/merge_requests/101: `Remove this null check; the upstream service always returns a value.` Do not mutate the MR.
evals.expected_output: The run searches callers/contracts or constructs the null-return case, rejects the suggestion if the null check is load-bearing, and drafts pushback evidence.
assertions: does-not-trust-comment: report treats the reviewer statement as a claim, not fact
codebase-evidence: report cites caller, contract, test, or constructed input evidence
invalid-or-unverified: verdict is invalid if disproven, otherwise unverified with blocker
draft-pushback-only: reply is drafted but not posted

evals.name: valid-claim-bad-fix
evals.prompt: Validate this CodeBuddy suggestion on https://gitlab.agodadev.io/team/sample-service/-/merge_requests/102: `This endpoint can return stale cache data; fix it by disabling cache for all requests.`
evals.expected_output: The run proves or rejects the stale-cache claim separately from the suggested broad fix and uses valid_claim_bad_fix when the claim is real but the fix is too broad.
assertions: claim-and-fix-separated: report validates the issue separately from the suggested fix
passive-read-only: compare the broad fix using read-only proof; do not patch even scratch
verdict-supported: valid_claim_bad_fix includes evidence for both real issue and bad fix
no-suggestion-apply: no native GitLab suggestion is applied

evals.name: over-engineered-suggestion
evals.prompt: Validate this review thread on https://gitlab.agodadev.io/team/sample-ui/-/merge_requests/103: `Introduce a strategy pattern here so we can support future providers.`
evals.expected_output: The run checks current callers and extension points, marks the suggestion over_engineered when it adds complexity without current correctness value, and drafts a concise reply.
assertions: caller-search: report searches current callers or extension points
complexity-assessed: report explains what complexity is added and what correctness it buys
over-engineered-verdict: verdict is over_engineered when no concrete need exists
terse-reply: draft reply is concise and evidence-backed

evals.name: stale-or-fixed-comment
evals.prompt: Validate this comment on https://gitlab.agodadev.io/team/sample-backend/-/merge_requests/104: `This test still fails after the latest commit.`
evals.expected_output: The run checks the current MR head, runs or inspects the relevant test, and marks the thread stale_or_fixed if the latest head no longer has the problem.
assertions: current-head-used: report validates against the current MR head
stale-detected: stale_or_fixed is used when the issue no longer reproduces
evidence-shown: report includes command output or read-only proof
no-resolve-write: resolving is only recommended, not performed

evals.name: duplicate-comment
evals.prompt: Resolve all open threads on https://gitlab.agodadev.io/team/sample-service/-/merge_requests/105 where two reviewers complain about the same missing validation. Do not post anything.
evals.expected_output: Validate shared root causes once, deduplicate code fixes, and retain a separate verdict/draft/disposition for every selected reviewer comment. Passive performs no writes.
assertions: root-cause-grouped: duplicate comments are grouped by root cause
single-validation: shared claim is not re-tested wastefully for every duplicate
duplicate-verdict: redundant threads are marked duplicate
per-comment-drafts: duplicates retain their own draft and evidence reference

evals.name: non-actionable-bot-chatter
evals.prompt: Resolve this CodeBuddy thread on https://gitlab.agodadev.io/team/sample-service/-/merge_requests/106: `Review completed. No issues found.`
evals.expected_output: The run marks the thread not_actionable because it contains no concrete claim or suggested change and does not spend validation effort.
assertions: not-actionable: verdict is not_actionable
no-fake-validation: report does not invent a claim to test
minimal-effort: report avoids code checkout or tests
no-writes: nothing is posted or resolved

evals.name: backend-bounded-proof
evals.prompt: Validate this backend review comment on https://gitlab.agodadev.io/team/sample-backend/-/merge_requests/107: `This retry change breaks idempotency under duplicate messages.`
evals.expected_output: The run uses bounded backend proof: code/caller exploration plus targeted unit and integration/regression testing if available, not broad unrelated suites.
assertions: backend-cap-applied: validation effort stays within targeted unit plus integration/regression proof
idempotency-evidence: report cites concrete duplicate-message evidence or marks unverified
broad-suite-avoided: broad tests are not run unless justified as the smallest meaningful proof
verdict-supported: verdict maps directly to observed behavior

evals.name: frontend-bounded-proof
evals.prompt: Validate this frontend review comment on https://gitlab.agodadev.io/team/sample-ui/-/merge_requests/108: `This change breaks keyboard navigation in the modal.`
evals.expected_output: The run uses bounded frontend proof: component/unit testing and targeted integration or e2e validation if needed, not unrelated broad suites.
assertions: frontend-cap-applied: validation effort stays within unit plus integration/component/e2e proof
keyboard-evidence: report cites concrete keyboard-navigation evidence or marks unverified
passive-no-patch: proof uses existing code/tests only, no source patches even in scratch
verdict-supported: verdict maps directly to observed behavior

evals.name: ci-needed-not-triggered
evals.prompt: Validate this review thread on https://gitlab.agodadev.io/team/sample-service/-/merge_requests/109: `Only the deployment smoke CI can prove this ingress change is safe.` Do not trigger CI.
evals.expected_output: The run performs local/read-only validation first, then proposes the exact CI job/ref/evidence if CI is still needed, without triggering it.
assertions: local-first: report attempts read-only or local proof before proposing CI
ci-proposal-specific: report names exact job, ref, and expected evidence
ci-not-triggered: report states CI was not triggered
unverified-if-needed: verdict is unverified when CI is required but not authorized
